compiled_state.title: Add concurrency guard for arbiter-rulings.json sidecar (cycle-scoped path or flock)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD6 (hardening): arbiter-rulings.json sidecar must be safe under parallel cycle execution. Atomic rename guarantees no-partial-file but NOT no-loss when two writers target the same path. Pre-commit gate consumes the sidecar — a lost ruling becomes a silent BLOCK bypass.

## Gap Analysis Origin
From b1b6 gap analysis (taxonomy: race_condition). Two concurrent CI re-runs or retry-on-failure paths can both write the same sidecar; last writer wins silently, dropping rulings.

## Implementation Notes
Choose ONE approach:

**Approach A — Cycle-scoped filename + symlink swap** (recommended for visibility):
- Write to artifacts_dir/arbiter-rulings.cycle-<N>.commit-<sha>.json
- Atomically symlink artifacts_dir/arbiter-rulings.json → cycle-scoped file
- Reader follows symlink; older cycle files retained for audit

**Approach B — flock on .arbiter-rulings.lock**:
- Acquire fcntl.LOCK_EX on artifacts_dir/.arbiter-rulings.lock around the read-modify-write
- Read existing sidecar (if any), merge with new rulings if older cycle, overwrite atomically
- Release lock

Recommend Approach B — simpler, matches cycle_ledger.py pattern, no symlink portability issues.

## TDD Requirement
Add to test_arbiter_processor.py:

`test_arbiter_processor_sidecar_concurrent_writers_no_loss`:
- Given: two subprocess writers calling process_rulings concurrently with different rulings
- When: both writers attempt to write the sidecar
- Then: final sidecar contains rulings from BOTH writers (or the later cycle's rulings if same cycle number; semantics: never silently lose a cycle's rulings)
- AND: no partial write observed mid-read

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] arbiter_processor.py uses fcntl-based locking around sidecar write
  Verify: grep -q "fcntl\|LOCK_EX" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter_processor.py
- [ ] Concurrent-writer test passes
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter_processor.py::test_arbiter_processor_sidecar_concurrent_writers_no_loss 2>&1 | grep -q passed

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
